1_1_1.LABEL: Hourly wages and bonuses
1_1_1.DEFINITION: Incl: wages/bonuses for hourly retread-plant workers (production, maintenance, janitor, plant clerk), matching MRT Weekly Production Report hours. Excl: warehousing/distribution/sales/corporate office wages; production outside the MRT process.

1_1_2.LABEL: Management salaries
1_1_2.DEFINITION: Incl: salaries/bonuses for salaried retread-plant personnel matching MRT Weekly Production Report hours.

1_2.LABEL: Misc Labor (contract and temp production employees)
1_2.DEFINITION: Incl: wages for temporary/contract workers matching MRT Weekly Production Report hours.

1_3_6.LABEL: Employee Insurance – workers' comp
1_3_6.DEFINITION: Workers' compensation insurance for plant employees.

1_5.LABEL: Uniforms rental / laundry
1_5.DEFINITION: Incl: uniforms or shirt/trouser program, if provided.

2_1_1.LABEL: Depreciation
2_1_1.DEFINITION: Incl: "bricks & mortar", only if owned, 20-yr straight line. Excl: if renting (use 2.1.3); building-financing interest; land depreciation.

2_1_2.LABEL: Maintenance
2_1_2.DEFINITION: Incl: building maintenance, garbage removal fees.

2_1_3.LABEL: Rent
2_1_3.DEFINITION: Incl: building rental (only the retread-plant % of footage); leasehold improvements if owned. Excl: mortgage payments.

2_2.LABEL: Training Costs
2_2.DEFINITION: Incl: outside-trainer expense. Excl: trainer/trainee labor (use 1.1.1).

2_4.LABEL: Vehicle expenses (rubber dust trailer, shop truck)
2_4.DEFINITION: Incl: vehicles for retread-plant use only; rubber-dust trailer fees. Excl: sales/distribution/warehousing vehicles; vehicle insurance (use 2.7.3); forklifts (use 2.11.5).

2_5.LABEL: Telephone
2_5.DEFINITION: Incl: voice/modem/data lines for plant; cell phones for plant personnel.

2_6.LABEL: Travel and Entertainment
2_6.DEFINITION: Incl: travel for plant manager/employees (e.g. PMPC). Excl: owner/corporate travel; promotional/entertainment (sales cost).

2_7.LABEL: Insurance
2_7.DEFINITION: Incl: fire/theft/liability for the retread plant; plant-vehicle insurance (2.7.3). Excl: warehouse/sales insurance.

2_7_3.LABEL: Liability
2_7_3.DEFINITION: Liability insurance for the plant (incl. plant vehicles).

2_8.LABEL: Property Taxes
2_8.DEFINITION: Incl: property taxes for dealer-owned plant. Excl: if building rented; sales/income taxes.

2_9_1.LABEL: Shop Consumables (rasps, grinding wheels, brushes)
2_9_1.DEFINITION: Incl: buffing blades/brushes, grinding wheels. Excl: materials assembled to the tire (tread rubber, cushion gum, rope rubber, patches, cement, paint).

2_9_2.LABEL: Curing Consumables (envelopes, lube, wicks, poly)
2_9_2.DEFINITION: Incl: curing envelopes, wicks, envelope lube, poly.

2_9_3.LABEL: Miscellaneous
2_9_3.DEFINITION: Incl: janitorial supplies, treatment chemicals, etc.

2_9_4.LABEL: Office
2_9_4.DEFINITION: Incl: paper, pens, labels, office supplies.

2_10.LABEL: Utilities – gas, electric, water
2_10.DEFINITION: Incl: gas/electric/water for the plant (may be an allocated % if shared). Excl: utilities for other operations in the building.

2_11_1.LABEL: Maintenance
2_11_1.DEFINITION: Incl: equipment repairs/spare parts, computer maintenance, custom-mold cleaning. Excl: items under MRT warranty.

2_11_2.LABEL: Rental
2_11_2.DEFINITION: Incl: rental fees for air compressors, etc.

2_11_4.LABEL: Depreciation – MRT process equipment ($US only)
2_11_4.DEFINITION: Incl: MRT process equipment & installation at start-up/expansion (regardless of ownership); MRT mods > $5,000; 10-yr straight line (MRT provides value). Excl: non-MRT-process equipment. Reported in USD even on local-currency plants.

2_11_5.LABEL: Depreciation – Other shop equipment (boiler, cyclone, air compressors, capital cost of conversion)
2_11_5.DEFINITION: Incl: dealer-installed process support equipment, forklifts, capital conversion costs; 10-yr straight line (forklifts/computers use std methods). Excl: MRT-provided gas hot-water unit (in 2.11.4); equipment sales taxes; equipment financing interest.

2_11_6.LABEL: MRTI equipment leases or rent
2_11_6.DEFINITION: Incl: MRT software license fees (CIA, BIB TREAD); custom-mold rental. Excl: MRT process equipment rented from MRT/3rd party (in 2.11.4).

2_12.LABEL: Administration fees
2_12.DEFINITION: Incl: allocation for corporate accounting/payroll/personnel support (consistent monthly, not %-of-sales). Excl: corporate costs that would persist if plant closed (senior mgmt salaries, sales commissions).

2_13.LABEL: Inventory charge
2_13.DEFINITION: Interest charge/credit for money funding inventory of materials & consumables. Expense = positive; interest income = negative. Excl: casing/stock-casing inventory charges; equipment financing interest.

2_14.LABEL: Income from rubber dust sales
2_14.DEFINITION: Income from rubber-dust sales (enter as negative); or removal cost if not sold (positive). Excl: rubber-dust trailer rentals/fees (use 2.4).

2_15_1.LABEL: Casings scrapped in production (e.g. torn belts by buffer)
2_15_1.DEFINITION: Incl: cost of casings damaged by the plant during production (casing cost + disposal). Excl: RAR scrap disposal fees.

2_15_2.LABEL: Adjustments (customer returns, user price plus transportation both ways)
2_15_2.DEFINITION: Incl: materials/workmanship adjustment costs (fees, transport), shown in the month paid (not accrual), matching adjustments reported to MRT Quality. Excl: commercial concession adjustments; RAR disposal fees.

TOTAL_LABOR_OVERHEAD.LABEL: Total Labor & Overhead
TOTAL_LABOR_OVERHEAD.DEFINITION: Grand total: Total Labor + Total Overhead.
